name: Law of Insurance
new_code: name of the Act it belongs to (Insurance Act 1938, Marine Insurance Act 1963, Motor Vehicles Act 1988, LIC Act 1956, Contract Act 1872)
terms: 'insurer', 'insured', 'premium', 'policy', 'uberrima fides', 'insurable interest', 'indemnity', 'proximate cause', 'subrogation', 'contribution', 'warranty', 'nomination', 'assignment', 'total loss', 'abandonment', 'general average', 'third party', 'no-fault'

episodes.t: The Proposal That Was Never Accepted
episodes.s: LIC v Raja Vasireddy — what insurance is, its subject matter and principles, how the contract is formed, and the history in England and India
episodes.cover: Channell J.'s definition and the three elements; subject matter of insurance vs of the contract; the six principles; proposal, acceptance (Raja Vasireddy), Sec 64VB premium, cover note (Chandmull Jain), policy, commencement of risk; salary-savings cases (Basanti Devi); history — Lloyd's, Life Assurance Act 1774, MIA 1906; Oriental Life 1818, Bombay Mutual, Triton, 1912 and 1938 Acts, LIC 1956, GIBNA 1972, Malhotra, IRDA 1999, 2015, 2021, LIC IPO

episodes.s: Carter v Boehm — utmost good faith and Sec 45, warranties, indemnity, wager, conditional contracts, classification and construction of policies
episodes.cover: Duty of disclosure and representation, material fact (Satwant Kaur), exceptions (Carter v Boehm, Sec 20(3) MIA); Sec 45(1)-(5) after 2015 (Mithoolal Nayak, Asha Goel, Rekhaben Rathod, Manmohan Nanda); warranties and basis clause (Dawsons v Bonnin), conditions precedent (Sonell Clocks, Gurshinder Singh); indemnity (Castellain) and why life is not; insurance vs wager (Sec 30 Contract Act, Sec 6 MIA); contingent contract Secs 31-36; classification; rules of construction (Chandmull Jain, Sony Cheriyan, Garg Sons, Pushpalaya, Jacob Punnen)

episodes.t: The Timber That Belonged to the Company
episodes.s: Macaura v Northern Assurance — insurable interest, premium, risk and assignment
episodes.cover: Lucena v Craufurd and Sec 7 MIA definition; when interest must exist in life (Dalby), fire (Sadler's Co, Castellain, Sec 49 TPA), marine (Sec 8); who has interest in life and in property (Macaura, Canara Bank v United India, G.N. Sainani); premium, Sec 64VB, dishonoured cheque (Seema Malhotra, Inderjit Kaur), days of grace, lapse, revival, return of premium; risk — description, commencement, alteration and increase; assignment of life policies Sec 38 (2015), fire policies with consent, motor Sec 157, marine Sec 52

episodes.t: The Ship That Sank in Harbour
episodes.s: Leyland Shipping v Norwich Union — proximate cause, nomination, contribution, subrogation, double insurance, reinsurance
episodes.cover: Sec 57 MIA; Leyland, Pawsey, Marsden, Wayne Tank, Zuari Industries, Samayanallur, Sikka Papers, Rita Devi, Alka Shukla; non-disclosure checklist; nomination Sec 39, Sarbati Devi and Sec 39(7) beneficial nominee; double insurance Sec 34 and contribution Sec 82 (North British v London Liverpool, Levi Strauss); subrogation Sec 81 (Castellain, Yorkshire v Nisbet, Economic Transport v Charan Spinning); reinsurance Sec 101A, GIC Re, foreign branches

episodes.t: The Man Who Hid His Illness
episodes.s: Mithoolal Nayak — life insurance from definition to settlement of claims, and the LIC Act
episodes.cover: Sec 2(11) and features; kinds table (term, whole life, endowment, money-back, annuity, ULIP, group, micro); formation, free-look, age, Sec 113 surrender value; conditions (suicide clause, revival, accident benefit exclusions); circumstances affecting risk; assignment vs nomination, MWP Act Sec 6; amounts recoverable and persons entitled; claim settlement timelines, Ombudsman, consumer forum, Sec 37 guarantee; LIC Act Secs 3, 6, 7, 21, 24-28, 30, 37, 43, 2021 changes; LIC v CERC, Basanti Devi, Alka Shukla, Shakti Yezdani

episodes.s: Harris v Poland — fire insurance: meaning of fire, the policy, indemnity and reinstatement, proximate cause, kinds, conditions, average, rights after loss
episodes.cover: Sec 2(6A); the six features; fire = ignition (Austin v Drewe, Stanley v Western, Harris v Poland, Everett); consequences covered; Standard Fire and Special Perils Policy's twelve perils; formation; indemnity measure; reinstatement option and reinstatement value clause; causa proxima illustrations (Sikka Papers); kinds table (specific, valued, floating, declaration, reinstatement, first loss, loss of profits); the fifteen conditions incl. alteration, notice of loss, no abandonment, right of entry, arbitration, time bar (Sujir Ganesh Nayak); average formula; Sec 64UM surveyors (Venkateswara Syndicate); Canara Bank v United India; Sony Cheriyan

episodes.t: The Ship That Sank in a Calm Sea
episodes.s: The Popi M — the marine insurance contract: adventure, interest, disclosure, policy, warranties, deviation and change of voyage, perils of the sea
episodes.cover: MIA 1963 Secs 3-5, 2(e); insurable interest Secs 6-18; disclosure Secs 19-22; formation Secs 23-33; classification table (voyage, time, mixed, valued, unvalued, floating, open, ICC A/B/C); warranties Secs 35-43 incl. seaworthiness Sec 41 (Star Sea); voyage Secs 44-51 — change of voyage vs deviation, delay, excuses; perils of the seas (Popi M, Inchmaree, Canada Rice Mills, Gaunt), pirates, thieves, barratry, restraint of princes, all other perils; Hira Lal Ramesh Chand

episodes.s: The Inchmaree — losses: total and partial, actual and constructive total loss, notice of abandonment, particular and general average, salvage, sue and labour, Inchmaree clause
episodes.cover: Sec 57 included/excluded losses; Sec 58 kinds; Sec 59 actual total loss (Asfar v Blundell), Sec 60 missing ship; Sec 62-63 CTL and prudent owner test (Ruys); Sec 64-65 notice of abandonment rules and effect (Kaltenbach); Sec 66 particular average, Sec 67 salvage, Sec 68 general average essentials and York-Antwerp (Birkley v Presgrave); measure of indemnity Secs 69-79; Sec 80 sue and labour; Inchmaree clause contents; Secs 81-86 subrogation, contribution, under-insurance, return of premium (Yorkshire v Nisbet)

episodes.t: The Shop That Was Robbed Quietly
episodes.s: Harchand Rai — burglary, personal accident and guarantee insurance
episodes.cover: Burglary policy scope; meaning of burglary — IPC 442-445 / BNS vs policy definition 'forcible and violent entry' (George and Goldsmiths, Calf, Dino Services, Harchand Rai); twelve exceptions; accident insurance as benefit policy; 'accident' (Fenton v Thorley), external violent visible means, proximate cause (Alka Shukla, Etherington, Rita Devi), exceptions; guarantee insurance kinds; guarantee (Sec 126) vs insurance (Seaton v Heath) — eight differences; fidelity policies and conditions (Holloway); credit insurance, ECGC (Garg Sons), DICGC, surety bonds

episodes.s: Public Liability Insurance Act — liability insurance, the insurer's defence of the assured, statutory subrogation, employer's liability
episodes.cover: Nature and kinds, occurrence vs claims-made; conduct-and-control condition, duty to defend, Sec 170 MV Act (Nicolletta Rohtagi, Shankarayya); Third Parties (Rights against Insurers) Act 1930; Secs 150-151 MV Act, Sec 14 EC Act, pay and recover Sec 150(4)-(5) (Nanjappan); practice; employer's liability — EC Act Secs 3, 4, 12, 14, 17, 3(5) (Agnes), ESI Act Secs 53, 61, the WC policy; PLI Act 1991 Secs 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 7A, 8, 14 and NGT; professional indemnity (Jacob Mathew, V.P. Shantha), product liability CPA 2019, D and O, cyber; M.C. Mehta, Union Carbide

episodes.s: Skandia v Kokilaben — motor vehicle insurance under Chapter XI and XII of the Motor Vehicles Act after 2019
episodes.cover: Secs 145, 146, 147 (limits ₹7.5 lakh property), 149 new, 150 (old 149) duty and three defences, 150(4)-(5), 151, 152-160, 157 transfer, 161 hit and run, 164 no-fault ₹5 lakh/₹2.5 lakh, 164B Fund; Tribunals Secs 165-176, 166(3) six months, 173 appeal; case law — Skandia, Sohan Lal Passi, Swaran Singh, Mukund Dewangan/Rambha Devi, Pepsu, Asha Rani, Baljit Kaur, Dhanraj, Jhuma Saha, Inderjit Kaur, Seema Malhotra, Amrit Paul Singh; clauses restricting cover — driver, use, passengers, statutory vs contractual liability (Pradeep Kumar); compensation — Sarla Verma, Pranay Sethi, Magma, Hattangadi, Raj Kumar, Kajal

episodes.t: The Scandal That Shook the New Corporation
episodes.s: The Mundhra affair — the Insurance Act, LIC Act, GIBNA, Marine Insurance Act, Motor Vehicles Act and IRDA Act in outline; the Ombudsman and the industry
episodes.cover: Insurance Act part by part — Secs 2, 2C, 3, 6, 10, 13, 27-29, 31B, 32B-C, 33-37A, 38-39, 40-42E, 45, 46, 47, 52A-58, 64C-64R, 64UM, 64V-64VB, 101A-C, 102-105C, 110, 113, 114-114A; 2015 and 2021 amendments, 2024 proposals; LIC Act Secs 3-7, 21, 24-28, 30, 37, 43, 2021 listing; GIBNA Secs 4, 5, 9, 10, 16, 19, 2002 delinking, 2021 amendment; MIA and MV Act outlines; IRDA Act Secs 3, 14(a)-(q), 26, 28-30; Ombudsman Rules 2017/2021, policyholder regulations 2017/2024, CPA 2019 (Harsolia Motors), SAT; the industry's numbers; LIC v CERC, LIC v Escorts, Jacob Punnen
